libs.note: BH-9499. The in-build general review gets the lead-review checklist and the plan's `## Requirements coverage` rows as R1..Rn, and writes one COVERAGE-ROW line per row; cv_enforce (inside LENS_APPROVED) turns an APPROVE into a BLOCK on a missing, contradicting or untraced row. Resolved by cv_conf through lib_env_apply in a subshell, then the env, then the CV_DEFAULT_* values in bin/lib/coverage-review.sh, which equal the defaults here (tests/coverage-review.bh-9499-test.sh K1).

knobs.note: 1: an APPROVE in review.md with a coverage row that is missing, contradicts, has no COVERAGE-ROW line, or has no evidence gets `[BLOCK wrong-data]` (or core-flow-broken) COVERAGE-GATE lines and VERDICT: BLOCK, so the build's fix round runs. 0: one `COVERAGE-GATE: would BLOCK` pipeline.log line, the verdict stands. Applies only to plans with coverage rows.
The most coverage rows the review note lists and the gate judges. Rows past it are named NOT JUDGED in the note and are not enforced. Bounds the prompt.
The largest checklist text (prompts/lead-review-checklist.md items 1..n, up to `## Changes`) the review note inlines. Over it, or 0, the note names the file for the reviewer to read instead.
